question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is option 2) i.e. '**puzzles**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: Word Meaning disputes a disagreement or argument. (विवाद) puzzles a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge. (पहेली, उलझन) debates to discuss a subject in a formal way. (बहस) conditions the state of something with regard to its appearance, quality, or working order. (परिस्थिति, हालत, अवस्था) • Let's look at the sentence: "...first of course there was Arithmetic – those five ___________ in Profit and Loss..." • **"Puzzles"** in this context refers to the different topics or exercises in the subject of arithmetic, particularly those related to profit and loss; a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "puzzles" to make the sentence meaningfully correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. ​ Complete passage:__ Swaminathan had a table on which all his things, his coat, cap, slate, ink-bottle, and books, were thrown in a confused (1) heap.
